name: Merezco un final feliz
source:
Once upon a time there was a prince, protagonist of a book whose author died before it was finished  — and for years, he's been waiting for someone who can help him.

As the latest person to find the book, you decide to help the prince as he attempts to both claim his place as the rightful heir to the throne and deal with the two mysterious strangers that he meets along the way. 

Will his story finally have a happy ending?

[From [url=https://maneatergames.itch.io/a-happy-ending]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前有一位王子，他是一本书的主角，这本书的作者在这本书完成之前就去世了——多年来，他一直在等待有人可以帮助他。

作为最新找到这本书的人，你决定帮助王子，因为他试图声称自己是王位的合法继承人，并处理他沿途遇到的两个神秘陌生人。

他的故事最终会有一个美好的结局吗？

[来自[url=https://maneatergames.itch.io/a-happy-ending]itch.io[/url]]
